run_nightly_test_report: run the nightly test report script to parse log files and post results to Slack
parse_test_log_files: parse JSON-lines test log files to extract passed and failed test outcomes with durations
generate_failed_test_table: generate a formatted grid table of failed tests using tabulate with test location, case, and name columns
build_slack_message_payload: build a Slack blocks payload with headers, sections, action buttons, and date context for test results
post_results_to_slack: post nightly test results to a Slack channel using the Slack WebClient with formatted message blocks
